sub-behaviors.group-created.meaning: Says on Behaviors that a new parent Behavior was saved together with its sub-behaviors.
sub-behaviors.group-created.text: {title} created with {count, plural, one {# sub-behavior} other {# sub-behaviors}}.

sub-behaviors.reordered.meaning: Says on Behaviors that the new order of a parent's sub-behaviors was saved.

sub-behaviors.added.meaning: Says on Behaviors that a Behavior now sits under a parent Behavior.

sub-behaviors.detached.meaning: Says on Behaviors that a sub-behavior left its parent and is now its own Behavior.

sub-behaviors.follows-parent.meaning: Says in the Behavior form that a sub-behavior uses its parent's schedule, so its own schedule fields are hidden.

sub-behaviors.check-row.meaning: Refuses a new parent Behavior when one of its drafted sub-behaviors is not valid.

sub-behaviors.routine-marked.meaning: Says on Timeline that a whole routine slot was marked Completed or Not Completed.
